The '''father''' of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] [[Masi Qual]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] being. Prior to the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he worked for the Bothan [[Galactic Senate/Legends|senatorial]] delegation on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the Empire came to power, he and his family fled to [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], where he would often rant angrily about the Empire.<ref name="OAA1" />
